reviews.text: The front wheel jammed on a sidewalk crack and nearly tipped the stroller forward.
The folding latch stuck so badly that I struggled to load it into the car alone.
The canopy looked large in photos but barely shaded my baby's face.
The brake pedal felt loose and did not lock both wheels every time.
The storage basket was too shallow and my diaper bag kept sliding out.
It rolled fine indoors, but rough pavement made it rattle loudly.
